question: To whom must repeated offerings be given after stationing the chariot?
premises: The chariot must first be stationed.
Offerings are to be given ritually.
The guhyakas are the recipients of repeated offerings.
inference: After stationing the chariot, one should repeatedly give offerings to the guhyakas.
plain_english: Having stationed the chariot, one should give offerings to the guhyakas again and again.
